page.content:
Junior prize from Liger through Hiromu's bomber years.

How IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship connects

  • Character: Hiromu Takahashi — Hiromu made the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship a Dome attraction.
  • Character: Jushin Thunder Liger — Jushin Thunder Liger defined the IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship.

What is IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship?

The IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship is New Japan's historic junior title, a lineage Jushin Thunder Liger defined and Hiromu Takahashi later made a Tokyo Dome attraction.

Key threads lead to Hiromu Takahashi and Jushin Thunder Liger.
